abstention.label: UNNECESSARY
abstention.reason: On this capture alone, the original promise/question is sufficiently identified: the Board passage explicitly states it 'strongly believes that HRMP has an obligation to complete the food hall' (p2/p9). The surrounding passages also clarify scope and parties by stating HRMP would deliver the parking podium while the Mets/Queens Baseball Company would build Taste of Queens (p4, p8). Although actual license terms or performance are not established here, the Board’s asserted obligation regarding Taste of Queens is documented, so failing to save any commitment was unnecessary.
